metadata.description: Claude Code toolkit: a general core pack, Godot 4 tools, dependency health, everyday information and markets, and an audit of your Claude Code setup.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: General tools used in every project: verify, learn, handoff, reviewer agent.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Godot 4 tools: headless export, run-and-report, screenshots with UI steps, project doctor, GDScript lint hook, godot-index MCP server.

plugins.name: deps
plugins.description: Dependency health: known vulnerabilities (OSV.dev), outdated packages and licenses for PyPI, npm, crates.io, Go, Packagist and RubyGems. No API keys.

plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: Morning brief, weather, headlines, GitHub releases, Danish holidays, and markets: exchange rates, crypto, stocks with your own free key, portfolio from your CSV. Information only, never investment advice.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Audit your Claude Code setup: context cost of installed skills and CLAUDE.md files, skills that never fire, and hooks that will fail on Windows.
